unlatched_review: Only the listed latch/lock parts lose collision; their visuals remain. Leaf, frame, handles and other hardware remain collidable.
clearance_review: A 2% moving fit and 3.1 mm latchward shift give about 0.35 mm hinge-side and 0.8 mm strike-side gaps. Recenter the opening on the fitted leaf; retain runtime tolerances.
modifications: Normalize the selected source to a centered, floor-aligned Z-up meter frame without reflection.
Use the source derivative with negligible-area triangles removed.
Apply only the recorded clearance, collider and hinge approximations; start closed and already unlatched.

collider_groups.review: The white and brass latch-side escutcheon, lock casing and handle-base fragments describe one rigid attached hardware assembly. Several are planar skins whose standalone PhysX decomposition thickens them into the fixed strike plate despite no source-surface crossings after fitting (attempt 000007). Cook a common solid envelope while retaining every visual component, the collidable assembly, and the separate lever-handle colliders. The separate latch tongue 69 remains the only excluded collider.
